notes.title: Update 3.3
notes.notes: [p]Now is the time for turn-based combat on the Moon!  This update features:[/p][p][/p][p]A new title intro!  Nice![/p][p]Updated NPC graphics!  Sweet![/p][p]New screen resolution choices!  Oh, cool.[/p][p]New climbing animations!  That's kind of cool too, I guess.[/p][p][/p][p]Be sure to check out 'The World Ends in Ohio' for more Midwest adventures!  It releases soon! [/p]

notes.title: Update 3.2
notes.notes: [p]Find the life you always wanted traveling all over the Moon with your robot pal and leave the spreadsheets, gridlocked traffic and overbearing homeowners associations on Earth![/p][p][/p][p]This update adds more vibrant battle scenes for intense robot and moon-monster combat!  There's some added dungeon and overworld animations which are pretty neat too.  [/p]

notes.title: Update 3.1
notes.notes:
There's a vast galaxy to explore and it's made entirely of glorious pixel art. Explore the Moon with your robot pal and forget about all those problems on Earth!

This update makes some improvements to the graphics and adds some new resolution options!  Great stuff all around.

There are space mutants coming from the far reaches of outer space to invade Earth, and the only way to stop them is with turn-based combat!

notes.title: Update 3.0
notes.notes:
Go on the pixel-art, outer space mission you always planned on, but kept putting off due to life's responsibilities.  With this awesome update, you get it all:

Improved animations!
Better graphics!
And much more!

You should be in outer space right now, launching nukes at giant, mutant Moon monsters.  If not, you have ask yourself why?

notes.title: Holiday Update
notes.notes:
You should be on the Moon right now, fighting giant robots.  Or at least doing that in an RPG if commercial Moon travel is not possible in the current scientific and financial climate.

Added some bug fixes and Steam Achievement updates.  Plus, there's an awesome new game logo to marvel at.  This update has it all.

notes.title: Update 2.2
notes.notes:
Bug fixes and graphical improvements will give you the Moon traveling experience you always wanted.

Fight against mutant pixel art monsters and save outer space!  There's a big, wide world out there... and it's filled with mutants. But you have a laser blaster and a robot pal, so it'll probably be okay.

notes.title: Update 2.1
notes.notes: Get ready for an improved visual experience with updates to the pixel art graphics.  Updated animations will help absorb you into the ultimate space adventure.  Don't spend the weekend on boring, old Earth. Go chill on the Moon in an RPG!

notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.notes:
A bunch of new graphics and gameplay updates!  Explore the Moon with your robot pal in style with new pixel art!  Instead of sitting around on Earth doing regular planet things, you could be on the Moon fighting off a mutant invasion.

Check it out!

It's a dangerous world out there. Luckily, you're friends with a robot who's got your back. Plus, you're on the Moon.
